town.label: Town
town.win: Wins when every other faction is gone.

mafia.label: Mafia
mafia.win: Wins when the Mafia equal or outnumber everyone else, unless an independent killer is still alive.

independent.label: Independent
independent.win: Wins when every other faction is gone.

cult.label: Cult
cult.win: This pack sets no win condition for the Cult; the host decides it.

executioner.label: Executioner
executioner.win: Wins if their chosen target is lynched.

condemner.label: Condemner
condemner.win: Wins if their chosen target is lynched.

bomb.text: Their night killer dies with them

hero.text: Kills whoever eliminates them by duel

miller.text: Reads as Scum to alignment checks

mason.text: Mason chat confirms members as Town

visitor_kill_target.text: Selective Visit Killers react to their visits

godfather.text: Reads as Town to alignment checks

flipless.text: Flips with role and alignment hidden

death_curse.text: Whoever causes their death dies too

win_witness.text: Reacts just before a faction wins

unstoppable_vengeful.text: Their killer dies with them, through protection

super_saint.text: The voter who lynches them dies

vanilla_townie.name: Vanilla Townie
vanilla_townie.summary: No special power. Wins with the Town through discussion and the vote.

bomb.name: Bomb
bomb.summary: A Townie who takes their night killer down with them.

x_voter.name: X-Voter
x_voter.summary: Their vote counts for more than one; in this pack, two.

voteless.name: Voteless
voteless.summary: May cast a vote, but it counts for nothing.

tiebreaker.name: Tiebreaker
tiebreaker.summary: If tied for elimination, they are the one eliminated.

innocent_child.name: Innocent Child
innocent_child.summary: During the day, may publicly confirm they are Town without revealing their role.

gladiator.name: Gladiator
gladiator.summary: By day, may challenge one player so only the two of them can be voted out that day.

hero.name: Hero
hero.summary: If eliminated by a duel-style day power, kills whoever started it.

day_self_destructor.name: Day Self-Destructor
day_self_destructor.summary: Once, by day, may self-destruct to take one player down before the vote.

white_wolf_king.name: White Wolf King
white_wolf_king.summary: By day, may self-destruct to take one player down. By night, has a kill of their own.

day_vigilante.name: Day Vigilante
day_vigilante.summary: Each day, may kill one player before the vote resolves.

governor.name: Governor
governor.summary: Once, after the vote is counted, may veto the day's elimination.

loved.name: Loved
loved.summary: Takes one extra vote to eliminate.

hated.name: Hated
hated.summary: A Mafia member who takes one fewer vote to eliminate.

miller.name: Miller
miller.summary: A Townie who reads as Scum to alignment checks.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.summary: Survives one ordinary kill. A Strongman's kill still lands.

ascetic.name: Ascetic
ascetic.summary: Immune to the pack's non-lethal actions, helpful or harmful.

rolestopper.name: Rolestopper
rolestopper.summary: Cannot be targeted, and each night may make one other player untargetable for that night.

shield.name: Shield
shield.summary: Each night, shields several players from targeted actions for that night.

macho_townie.name: Macho Townie
macho_townie.summary: Cannot be protected: kills aimed at them always land.

cop.name: Cop
cop.summary: Each night, investigates one player and learns whether they read Town or Scum.

vanilla_cop.name: Vanilla Cop
vanilla_cop.summary: Each night, checks whether one player has no special power.

neapolitan.name: Neapolitan
neapolitan.summary: Each night, checks whether one player is a Vanilla Townie.

gunsmith.name: Gunsmith
gunsmith.summary: Each night, checks whether one player's role carries a gun.

psychologist.name: Psychologist
psychologist.summary: Each night, checks whether one player's role can kill.

specialist.name: Specialist
specialist.summary: Each night, checks whether one player holds one of the setup's specialist roles.

pt_cop.name: PT Cop
pt_cop.summary: Each night, learns which private topics one player can read.

role_cop.name: Role Cop
role_cop.summary: Each night, learns one player's role.

coroner.name: Coroner
coroner.summary: Each night, examines one dead player and learns their role and alignment.

strong_willed_cop.name: Strong-Willed Cop
strong_willed_cop.summary: Investigates like a Cop, and roleblocks cannot stop it.

comparison_cop.name: Comparison Cop
comparison_cop.summary: Investigates one player, then on later checks learns whether their result has changed.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.summary: Each night, protects one player from a kill. A Strongman's kill still lands.

faith_healer.name: Faith Healer
faith_healer.summary: Each night, has an even chance to protect one player from an ordinary kill.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.summary: Each night, guards one player and dies stopping a kill aimed at them.

huntsman.name: Huntsman
huntsman.summary: Each night, guards one player; if they are attacked, dies stopping it and kills the attacker.

martyr.name: Martyr
martyr.summary: Each night, protects one player and dies in their place if they are attacked.

cpr_doctor.name: CPR Doctor
cpr_doctor.summary: Each night, saves one player if they are attacked, but kills them if they are not.

babysitter.name: Babysitter
babysitter.summary: Each night, protects one player, who dies too if the Babysitter dies.

jailkeeper.name: Jailkeeper
jailkeeper.summary: Each night, jails one player: they are blocked and protected by the same action.

roleblocker.name: Roleblocker
roleblocker.summary: Each night, blocks one player so their blockable action fails.

hooker.name: Hooker
hooker.summary: A Mafia roleblocker: each night, blocks one player's blockable action.

jailer.name: Jailer
jailer.summary: Each night, blocks one player so their blockable action fails.

mafia_roleblocker.name: Mafia Roleblocker
mafia_roleblocker.summary: Each night, blocks one player so their blockable action fails.

jack_of_all_trades.name: Jack of All Trades
jack_of_all_trades.summary: Holds four one-shot powers: an alignment check, a protection, a block and a track.

catastrophic_roleblocker.name: Catastrophic Roleblocker
catastrophic_roleblocker.summary: Each night, blocks every action one player submits.

commuter.name: Commuter
commuter.summary: Each night, may leave town and cannot be targeted that night.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.summary: Each night, follows one player and learns whom they visited.

follower.name: Follower
follower.summary: Each night, follows one player and learns what kind of action they took.

watcher.name: Watcher
watcher.summary: Each night, watches one player and learns who visited them.

role_watcher.name: Role Watcher
role_watcher.summary: Each night, watches one player and learns the roles, not the names, of their visitors.

role_guard.name: Role Guard
role_guard.summary: Each night, tells one player the roles, not the names, of whoever targeted them.

security_guard.name: Security Guard
security_guard.summary: Each night, tells one player who visited them.

odd_night_cop.name: Odd Night Cop
odd_night_cop.summary: A Cop who can investigate only on odd-numbered nights.

even_night_cop.name: Even Night Cop
even_night_cop.summary: A Cop who can investigate only on even-numbered nights.

odd_cycle_cop.name: Odd Cycle Cop
odd_cycle_cop.summary: A Cop who can investigate only in odd-numbered cycles.

even_cycle_cop.name: Even Cycle Cop
even_cycle_cop.summary: A Cop who can investigate only in even-numbered cycles.

weak_cop.name: Weak Cop
weak_cop.summary: A Cop who dies on finding Scum.

lazy_cop.name: Lazy Cop
lazy_cop.summary: A Cop who cannot act once only one non-Town player is left alive.

loud_cop.name: Loud Cop
loud_cop.summary: A Cop whose investigations are announced publicly.

announcing_cop.name: Announcing Cop
announcing_cop.summary: A Cop who publicly announces each investigation.

non_consecutive_cop.name: Non-Consecutive Cop
non_consecutive_cop.summary: A Cop who cannot check the same player on back-to-back nights.

indecisive_cop.name: Indecisive Cop
indecisive_cop.summary: A Cop who cannot check the same player two nights running.

cooldown_cop.name: Cooldown Cop
cooldown_cop.summary: A Cop who must rest one night after each investigation.

long_cooldown_cop.name: Long Cooldown Cop
long_cooldown_cop.summary: A Cop who must rest two nights after each investigation.

uncooperative_cop.name: Uncooperative Cop
uncooperative_cop.summary: A Cop whose results come back vague, as the setup defines.

roaming_cop.name: Roaming Cop
roaming_cop.summary: A Cop who can never check the same player twice.

disabled_endgame_cop.name: Disabled Endgame Cop
disabled_endgame_cop.summary: A Cop who cannot act once three or fewer players are alive.

novice_cop.name: Novice Cop
novice_cop.summary: A Cop whose investigations start on Night 2.

activated_cop.name: Activated Cop
activated_cop.summary: A Cop whose investigation switches on from Night 2.

compulsive_cop.name: Compulsive Cop
compulsive_cop.summary: A Cop who must investigate every night.

vigilante.name: Vigilante
vigilante.summary: Once per game, may kill one player at night.

two_shot_vigilante.name: Two-Shot Vigilante
two_shot_vigilante.summary: Twice per game, may kill one player at night.

simultaneous_vigilante.name: Simultaneous Vigilante
simultaneous_vigilante.summary: May kill several players in the same night.

motion_detector.name: Motion Detector
motion_detector.summary: Each night, learns whether one player acted or was visited.

visitor.name: Visitor
visitor.summary: Each night, visits one player. The visit does nothing, but others can see it.

friendly_neighbor.name: Friendly Neighbor
friendly_neighbor.summary: Each night, visits one player as a social gesture of Town trust.

neighborizer.name: Neighborizer
neighborizer.summary: Each night, visits one player to draw them into a private neighbourhood.

mailman.name: Mailman
mailman.summary: Each night, delivers an anonymous private message to one player.

observer.name: Observer
observer.summary: Each night, privately learns an observation about one player.

reporter.name: Reporter
reporter.summary: Each night, privately files a report about one player.

fruit_vendor.name: Fruit Vendor
fruit_vendor.summary: Each night, sends one player fruit. It has no effect beyond the gesture.

mason.name: Mason
mason.summary: Shares a private chat whose members are confirmed Town to each other.

neighbor.name: Neighbor
neighbor.summary: Shares a private chat, but its members learn nothing about each other's alignment.
neighbor.win: Has no alignment of their own; the host's setup decides how they win.

visitor_kill_target_visitor.name: Marked Visitor
visitor_kill_target_visitor.summary: Each night, visits one player, and carries a mark that a Selective Visit Killer reacts to.

traffic_analyst.name: Traffic Analyst
traffic_analyst.summary: Each night, learns whether one player had any visits before tonight.

bus_driver.name: Bus Driver
bus_driver.summary: Each night, swaps two players: actions aimed at one land on the other.

traffic_controller.name: Traffic Controller
traffic_controller.summary: Each night, rotates actions among three or more chosen players.

lightning_rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning_rod.summary: Each night, draws targeted actions onto themselves.

redirector.name: Redirector
redirector.summary: Each night, sends actions aimed at the first chosen player to the second.

mafia_goon.name: Mafia Goon
mafia_goon.summary: A Mafia member with no power of their own, who may carry the factional kill.

encryptor.name: Encryptor
encryptor.summary: A Mafia member whose presence opens a Mafia day chat while they live.

traitor.name: Traitor
traitor.summary: Wins with the Mafia but works alone: no Mafia chat and no factional kill.

lost_mafia_goon.name: Lost Mafia Goon
lost_mafia_goon.summary: A Mafia member who may carry the factional kill only once no other Mafia are alive.

recluse_mafia_goon.name: Recluse Mafia Goon
recluse_mafia_goon.summary: A Mafia member who may carry the factional kill only if every living teammate is also a Recluse.

framer.name: Framer
framer.summary: Each night, frames one player so an alignment check that night reads Scum.

lawyer.name: Lawyer
lawyer.summary: Each night, covers one player so an alignment check that night reads Town.

poisoner.name: Poisoner
poisoner.summary: Each night, poisons one player, who dies the next night unless cured.

poison_doctor.name: Poison Doctor
poison_doctor.summary: Each night, cures one poisoned player before the poison kills them.

arsonist.name: Arsonist
arsonist.summary: Douses one player a night, then may ignite to kill everyone doused at once.

cleanser.name: Cleanser
cleanser.summary: Each night, washes the douse off one player before an ignite.

godfather.name: Godfather
godfather.summary: Leads the Mafia, may carry the factional kill, and reads as Town to alignment checks.

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.summary: May carry the factional kill without showing up to trackers or watchers.

serial_killer.name: Serial Killer
serial_killer.summary: Kills one player each night. Wins only as the last faction standing.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.summary: No power. Wins alongside whoever wins, as long as they are alive at the end.
survivor.win: Wins alongside whoever wins, as long as they are alive at the end.

strongman.name: Strongman
strongman.summary: May carry the factional kill, which goes through protection.

mafia_janitor.name: Janitor
mafia_janitor.summary: May kill one player at night whose role stays hidden when they flip.

flipless_townie.name: Flipless Townie
flipless_townie.summary: A Townie whose role and alignment stay hidden when they die.

alignment_only_townie.name: Alignment-Only Townie
alignment_only_townie.summary: A Townie whose death reveals their alignment but not their role.

motivator.name: Motivator
motivator.summary: Each night, gives one player a single extra action.

inventor.name: Inventor
inventor.summary: Each night, gives one player a single-use item or a bulletproof vest.

cultist.name: Cultist
cultist.summary: Recruited by a Cult Leader. Wins with the Cult.

cult_leader.name: Cult Leader
cult_leader.summary: Each night, converts one player into a Cultist.

disloyal_cult_leader.name: Disloyal Cult Leader
disloyal_cult_leader.summary: Each night, may convert one player, but only one outside the Cult.

deprogrammer.name: Deprogrammer
deprogrammer.summary: Each night, restores one converted player to their original role and alignment.

vanillaiser.name: Vanillaiser
vanillaiser.summary: Each night, turns one player into a Vanilla Townie. A Deprogrammer can undo it.

vanillizer.name: Vanillizer
vanillizer.summary: Each night, turns one player into a Vanilla Townie. A Deprogrammer can undo it.

backup_cop.name: Backup Cop
backup_cop.summary: Becomes the Cop if the Cop dies.

universal_backup.name: Universal Backup
universal_backup.summary: Chooses one player and inherits their role if they die.

vengeful.name: Vengeful
vengeful.summary: When killed, takes their killer down with them.

death_cursed_townie.name: Death-Cursed Townie
death_cursed_townie.summary: Whatever kills them, the one responsible dies too.

death_marker.name: Death Marker
death_marker.summary: Each night, marks one player for death.

phase_end_doomed_townie.name: Doomed Townie
phase_end_doomed_townie.summary: Carries a doom that triggers when a phase ends.

win_witness_townie.name: Win Witness
win_witness_townie.summary: Carries a passive power that triggers just before a faction wins.

unstoppable_vengeful_townie.name: Unstoppable Vengeful
unstoppable_vengeful_townie.summary: When killed, takes their killer down, through any protection.

super_saint.name: Super-Saint
super_saint.summary: If lynched, the voter who sealed the lynch dies too.

beloved_princess.name: Beloved Princess
beloved_princess.summary: When killed, the host may skip the next day.

virgin.name: Virgin
virgin.summary: When killed, the host may skip the next day.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.summary: Picks a target, and wins if that target is lynched.

condemner.name: Condemner
condemner.summary: Picks a target, and wins if that target is lynched.

paranoid_gun_owner.name: Paranoid Gun Owner
paranoid_gun_owner.summary: Shoots everyone who visits them at night.

selective_visit_killer.name: Selective Visit Killer
selective_visit_killer.summary: Kills only visitors who carry a Marked Visitor's mark.

cupid.name: Cupid
cupid.summary: Links two players as lovers. If one dies, so does the other.

lover.name: Lover
lover.summary: Bound to another Lover. If either dies, by any means, so does the other.
lover.win: Lives and dies with their partner; the host's setup decides how they win.

saulus.name: Saulus
saulus.summary: Starts as Mafia. Survives their first lynch by turning Town.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.summary: Picks a target each night. If the Hunter dies, that target dies too.

hider.name: Hider
hider.summary: Each night, hides behind one player: safe from direct targeting if they are not Mafia, but dies if they die.
